visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with shoulder-length brown hair, wearing a white oversized top with lace sleeves and blue denim jeans, leans her head against her clasped hands in a kitchen setting. A man in a black long-sleeve shirt and black pants with white side stripes stands next to her, both smiling warmly. The background features a white tiled wall, kitchen cabinets, and a sink. Red text "POV: 老婆眼中的我" appears at the bottom. (2) The man is now dressed in a professional white chef's jacket and a tall white toque, holding a large plate featuring a golden-brown roasted chicken garnished with potatoes and herbs. The woman maintains her pose beside him. On the counter, a stainless steel pot and several stalks of green onions are visible. Red text "POV: 老婆肚子餓" is displayed. (3) In a quick transition, the man wears a wrestling singlet with "TAIWAN TIGER" text and a tiger-themed luchador mask. He continues to hold the same plate of roasted chicken. The lighting is bright and even across the kitchen studio. The woman's expression remains consistent. Red text "POV: 老婆遇到壞人" appears. (4) The man is transformed into a traditional Chinese emperor, wearing ornate yellow dragon robes and a ceremonial beaded crown. He holds the chicken plate towards the camera. The kitchen background is still clearly visible with its modern appliances. Red text "POV: 老婆想當王妃" is centered at the bottom. (5) The man wears a large, white prop airplane costume that wraps around his torso, while still presenting the roasted bird on the plate. The woman stands close to him, leaning her head on her hands. The scene is static except for the costume changes. Red text "POV: 老婆想出國" is shown. (6) The man is now inside a full-body brown T-Rex dinosaur costume, holding the plate of food near the dinosaur's snout. The woman smiles beside the prehistoric creature in the domestic kitchen environment. Red text "POV: 老婆想養暴龍" is overlaid on the frame. (7) Dressed in a dark suit, the man sports a massive pile of thick, shiny gold-colored chains around his neck, smiling with exaggerated confidence. He no longer holds the plate. The woman remains in her signature pose next to him. Red text "POV: 老婆突然缺錢" appears at the bottom. (8) The final phase shows a digital montage where approximately twelve copies of the man in his original black shirt are layered behind the woman, filling the upper part of the frame. The woman continues to lean on her hands, smiling. Red text "POV: 老婆想要很多我" is the final subtitle.
